data.name: wekan
data.description: FLOSS kanban, built with Meteor. Official Public Support at GitHub issues only. Official Private Pre-Paid Support at https://wekan.fi/commercial-support/ only. Translation PRs to imports/i18n/data/en.i18n.json, other translations at https://app.transifex.com/wekan/wekan . No telemetry.

data.name: v12.58
data.body:
## In short

an existing board can be **saved as a board template**, large
**Jira** exports import instead of failing, and **comments** stay with a card
moved to another board. A **GitHub CodeQL** alert in a test is fixed.

Thanks to above GitHub users for their contributions.

[More details at ChangeLog](https://github.com/wekan/wekan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#v1258-2026-10-21-wekan--release)
